Space Invaders
What are these little aliens doing here? These guys are easy to deal with, but watch out for the Squid's slightly tougher attack, and don't be surprised when the Octopus tanks your first hit.
UFO

A rare Space Invader that might appear every now and then. Really annoying, and much harder to hit than their, brothers? Sisters? Do aliens even have genders or do they just go through mitosis? Whatever, these guys won't harm you, so just kill them without worrying about repercussions.
Child Soldier

The stone cold killing machines of '16, these kids have been through hell. Few returned to their cradles and mama's breasts, but the ones that did were the baddest. Toughest. They enjoyed the soft life for a few years, but were sent to an operation to liberate the Sewers. Now they're fighting gators, mages, rats, mold... and YOU.
Child Commander

The other rank in the Child Army. The Commanders make up 6% of the army, while the Soldiers make up the other 92%. The Commanders wield the stronger Spiral Lollies, and can take a little more damage. A little.
Child War Hero
Some soldiers in the Army were given the title of "War Hero" after their outstanding acts of courage and skill in warfare. They face the enemy head on, with great force.
Aeolosaurus

According to all known laws of aviation, there is no way that an Aeolosaurus should be able to fly. Its wings are too small to get its big fat body off the ground. The Aeolosaurus, of course, doesn't fly then. What did you expect, for a 4 ton animal to soar like a bird? They GLIDE, which is (somehow) possible.
Sewer Gator

The badass forces of Sewer nature, Sewer Gators launch from the murky waters and eat whatever they can in one bite. When they're not hungry, they all work out at the Sewer Gym. So they're really strong. But they're also vulnerable to attacks from below, because of them only working their arms and jaw.
Mecha Gator

A crude imitation of Sewer nature, these robots were introduced to eliminate dangerous wildlife. However, they didn't have much success. So, the Government pulled its budget to more pressing matters, like turning the crocs gay. Now, these guys are rotting in the Sewers, all the while having to fight against a horde of Gators with a vendetta against them.
Ol' Gator
Larger than other Gators, this grizzled gator barely has any teeth. It's digestive system has also weakened with time, which is why it spits out all the bones of its prey.
Ankylosaurus
Good luck taking this thing down.
Majester

These fire mages are weird. It's like they are filled to the brim with explosives, but they're actually very reclusive when they're not firing walls of balls of flames at you. They are all sons of the Megajester, and are also his loyal warriors. There are only 13 of them however. It's because of their unholy pact that they keep reappearing. And keep casting fire magic.
Madjester
A Majester who stumbled upon a weird crystal; he was corrupted by it, and was abandoned by his brothers.
Domar
Well this should be no challenge. A tiny, flimsy nerd. Kick his ass, kickass!
I wonder who wears such weird glasses like this... No idea!
